steps.name: Stage 1 — Iterative Feature Selection & Stratified Split
steps.description: Joins 3 raw tables. Runs 5-fold CV ablation study to dynamically select features. Splits 80/20 using StratifiedGroupKFold to maintain class proportions.
steps.why: Creates an analysis-ready dataset with optimal features backed by performance metrics, while guaranteeing no leakage across train/test and balanced class ratios.

steps.name: Stage 2 — Train Risk Score Regressor & Ablation Test
steps.description: Tunes Ridge and DecisionTree Regressor to predict number_of_casualties via CV GridSearch. Generates risk_score using OOF predictions. Tests if risk_score improves macro-F1 classification vs just number_of_casualties.
steps.why: Determines the absolute best model for generating the risk_score continuous signal, and rigorously proves whether that signal is mathematically justified before keeping it.
